title: The Lost Locket
scene: At 7:25 PM, a silver locket vanished from a cruise cabin. A lifeboat drill locked the corridor from 7:15 to 7:40.

suspects.name: Bea Merrill
suspects.testimony: I was making beds in cabin twelve at 7:25, down the hall.
suspects.alibiProof: The housekeeping tablet shows Bea's key card at cabin twelve at 7:23.

suspects.name: Hugo Pike
suspects.testimony: I was on deck for the drill at 7:25 with my life vest on.
suspects.alibiProof: The drill roll call lists Hugo at station four at 7:24.

suspects.name: Ingrid Vale
suspects.testimony: I was in the lounge at 7:25, listening to the band play.
suspects.contradiction: The lounge band started at 7:31, and the locket clasp was in Ingrid's purse.

suspects.name: Rafael Ash
suspects.testimony: I was photographing the drill from the stairwell at 7:25.
suspects.alibiProof: Rafael's camera has twelve drill photos timestamped 7:20 to 7:26.
